overview: A spawner becomes a thing you can take with you, in pieces. Break one for shards, and nine shards build it back.

1.0.1: An advancement for spending a rebuilt spawner on a dragon, given to whoever is standing nearest as the cage goes.
1.0.0: Spawners break into shards, one or two with any pickaxe and more with Silk Touch or Fortune, and nine shards fill a table to make one back. A crafted spawner starts blank until a mob head tells it what to spawn, and a dragon head buys one dragon: the spawner is spent the moment it fires.
